entities.name: Conditional reconfiguration evaluation
entities.description: Procedure where the UE evaluates conditional reconfiguration conditions to determine if reconfiguration should be triggered.

entities.name: VarConditionalReconfig
entities.description: Stores conditional reconfiguration information including condReconfigId and associated configurations.

entities.name: condRRCReconfig
entities.description: Contains the RRCReconfiguration that would be applied if conditions are met.

entities.name: Applicable cell
entities.description: Cell with physical cell identity matching the value in ServingCellConfigCommon within reconfigurationWithSync.

entities.name: condExecutionCond
entities.description: Contains measurement conditions for conditional reconfiguration evaluation.

entities.name: condExecutionCondSCG
entities.description: Contains measurement conditions for SCG in conditional reconfiguration evaluation.

entities.name: condEventId
entities.description: Identifies the specific conditional event type (T1, D1, A3, A4, A5).

entities.name: condTriggerConfig
entities.description: Contains trigger configuration including event conditions and timeToTrigger parameters.

entities.name: Event fulfilled
entities.description: Condition where entry conditions for a measurement event are met.

entities.name: Triggered cell
entities.description: Target candidate cell where all measurement events are fulfilled.

entities.name: Conditional reconfiguration execution
entities.description: Procedure initiated when conditional reconfiguration conditions are met.

relations.description: Procedure iterates over each condReconfigId within VarConditionalReconfig.
RRCReconfiguration defines which cells are considered applicable based on physical cell identity matching.
condExecutionCond contains measId values that are associated with condEventId.
condEventId is part of the condTriggerConfig within VarConditionalReconfig.
Event fulfillment depends on entry/leaving conditions associated with condEventId.
When all events for a target candidate cell are fulfilled, the cell becomes triggered.
Detection of triggered cell initiates conditional reconfiguration execution procedure.
